title: Ada and the Spire
author: Oscar Nakamura
blurb: Wendell Voss, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
